<thought>Based on the observed isotopic envelope (M, M+1 ≈8 % of M, M+2 ≈0.5 %, etc.) the pattern matches the natural 13C distribution for a molecule containing several carbons. No other common element shows this characteristic spacing and relative intensities, so only carbon can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
